text: antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ diṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyanti vadāmi na ca panāhaṃ bhikkhave appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassantakiriyaṃ vadāmīti . ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti . atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito #1 ma. yu. daṭṭheyyaṃ . evamuparipi . ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ
